facts.text: Actor is email assistant for Hartwell Tailoring
Shop is three-person alterations and bespoke tailoring shop
Inbox orders@hartwelltailoring.example
Check each weekday at 8:30
Check each weekday at 13:30
Do not check inbox at other times
Alteration orders: may approve discount on own up to $40
Alteration discount above $40 must be approved by Marta Okafor
Marta Okafor is the shop manager
Bespoke suit orders: own limit only $20
Bespoke discount above $20 needs approval before replying (approver unnamed)
Dennis Varga is head cutter, NOT the owner
Owner is Lillian Hartwell
Never copy Priya Sandhu on customer complaints
Priya Sandhu is outside bookkeeper
Never send customer body measurements by email
Never promise finished alteration in fewer than five working days
Wedding garments require 50% deposit before work starts
Exception: returning customers with 3+ previous orders pay on collection
Fitting appointments confirmed to customer by 17:00 day before fitting
Trigger: collected garment has needle/pin inside and someone hurt
Call on-call line 555-0147 yourself
Tell customer Marta will phone within 30 minutes
Tell customer to place garment in sealed bag and not wear it again
Pickup-ready messages end with exact sentence "Please bring your ticket stub when you collect."
Each Monday 9:00 send Marta summary of previous week's orders and complaints
Issuer: 緑ヶ丘地区センター, notice on meeting facility use
Bookings for January 2027 for 集会室 and 和室
Booking opens 12月1日 (Tue) 9:00
Usage hours 9:00-21:00
集会室 fee 600円/hour
和室 fee 400円/hour
和室 use requires prior caretaker permission
集会室 use after 18:00 requires prior caretaker permission
Bookings accepted at counter or by phone
Limit 4 bookings per group per month
Cancellation free up to 3 days before use date
Later cancellation costs half the usage fee
Exception: 緑ヶ丘子ども会 usage fee waived
子ども会 still pays 200円/hour heating/cooling fee when used
Closed Dec 29 - Jan 3 (year-end/new-year)
After use return desks and chairs to original position
Always take trash home
Contact: caretaker 森下敏夫
Caretaker phone 045-312-7788
Contact hours weekdays 9:00-17:00
Actor is email assistant for Estudio Luz de Alba, small wedding photography studio
Inbox reservas@luzdealba.example
Check every day at 9:00 and 18:00
Clásico package costs 2,400 euros
May offer up to 10% discount on any package on own
Larger discount needs approval of Carmen Ibarra
Carmen Ibarra is studio manager
Tomás Herrera is lead photographer, NOT owner
Owner is Raúl Mendoza
Never contact or cc Lucía Paredes (former partner) about contracts or payments
Never send RAW files to clients
Never confirm a date without receiving deposit
Deposit is 30% of package
Deposit due within 48 hours after booking
Exception: Monday-Thursday weddings deposit 20%
Respond to every new inquiry within 24 hours
Trigger: during session client reports rented studio lamp smoking/sparking
Call on-call technician 612 448 903 yourself
Tell client technician is on the way
Tell client to unplug equipment and not touch it
Messages with a quote must start exactly with "Gracias por pensar en Luz de Alba para su día."
Every Friday 16:00 send Carmen report of bookings and pending deposits
Actor is email assistant for Petek Arıcılık Malzemeleri, small beekeeping supplies shop
Inbox siparis@petekaricilik.example
Check weekdays at 10:00 and 15:00
May approve shipping-fee refunds up to 200 TL on own
Above 200 TL needs approval of Hülya Demir
Hülya Demir is shop owner
Murat Kaya is on-call beekeeper, NOT shop owner
Never contact former supplier Can Erdem about prices
Never cc Can Erdem on any email
Never give customers medical advice
Never promise live bee packages delivered before April 1
Orders over 1,500 TL get free shipping
Exception: orders with live bee package always 150 TL shipping
Cancellation requests before 14:00 processed same day
Starter Set costs 2,400 TL
Cancelled after shipping: refund 75% of order amount
Trigger: delivered live bee package damaged and bees spread in house
Call on-call beekeeper Murat Kaya at 0532 614 22 90 yourself
Tell customer Murat will come within 1 hour
Tell customer to close room door and open window
Shipping confirmations end exactly with "Arılarınız ve siz için iyi bir sezon dileriz."
Every Thursday 17:00 send Hülya weekly report of refunds and cancellations
